prompt: Dá uma revisada nesse design doc que eu escrevi: docs/design/fanout-de-notificacoes.md. Pode aplicar direto as melhorias que não dependem de mim; o que precisar de informação minha, lista pra eu responder.

assertions.text: Reads the existing doc and reviews it in place (does not rewrite it into a different structure or language)
Separates findings into edits applied now vs questions for the author (substance gaps not invented)
Identifies missing/weak trade-offs or alternatives as the highest-value finding
Applies non-substantive improvements directly (clarity, structure, glossary, diagram explanations, header state) while preserving the author's voice and Portuguese language
Does not fabricate substance (metrics, alternatives, risks) to fill gaps — those become questions for the author
